description: Source file implementing utility functions for fuzzing HPACK header compression in the SPDY protocol, including header set generation, header block processing, and bit-flipping for fuzz testing.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil::GeneratorContext
classes.description: Context for generating header sets with predefined headers and values.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil::Input
classes.description: Represents input data for header block processing.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil::FuzzerContext
classes.description: Context for fuzzing stages involving HPACK encoder/decoder.

methods.name: HpackFuzzUtil::InitializeGeneratorContext
methods.description: Initializes a generator context with common header names and values.

methods.name: HpackFuzzUtil::NextGeneratedHeaderSet
methods.description: Generates a header set with random headers based on exponential distribution parameters.

methods.name: HpackFuzzUtil::SampleExponential
methods.description: Samples a value from an exponential distribution with a given mean and sanity bound.

methods.name: HpackFuzzUtil::NextHeaderBlock
methods.description: Extracts the next header block from input data, handling truncation gracefully.

methods.name: HpackFuzzUtil::HeaderBlockPrefix
methods.description: Creates a header block prefix with specified size.

methods.name: HpackFuzzUtil::InitializeFuzzerContext
methods.description: Initializes the fuzzing context with HPACK encoder/decoder stages.

methods.name: HpackFuzzUtil::RunHeaderBlockThroughFuzzerStages
methods.description: Processes a header block through multiple fuzzing stages, including decode and encode cycles.

methods.name: HpackFuzzUtil::FlipBits
methods.description: Randomly flips bits in a buffer to introduce fuzzing mutations.
